note: Re-judged 2026-10-31 by an independent auditor who authored none of the change. RFC text (rfc9687): "releases all BGP resources" be95c10053 adds acceptingPolicies(t, settings) so the EBGP session's routes reach the RIB under RFC 8212. Without it the RIB would hold neither route and the test's precondition (both wire routes present before the timer, routes == 2) would fail; with it the test still shows both routes held, then the peer and its RIB storage released, the session Idle and the Send Hold Timer Expired NOTIFICATION on the wire. Assertions unchanged. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgements are in this file's git history.
